definition: Defined by inverting a predecessor: the style takes its identity from what it refuses, as Greek Revival answered Federal delicacy with mass. A reaction passes on no part of the kit, and it commonly stands beside a descent from the same predecessor.
more: English Palladian reacts against English Baroque and inherits its trades; French Neoclassical repudiates the Baroque surface while continuing its plan types and stonecutting. The reaction and the descent are both true, and both are recorded.
basis: schema/style-node.schema.json: "reacts_against = defined by inversion of a predecessor." docs/model.md marks it as not carrying the kit, "Defined by inversion of a predecessor | **No**", and says "A style commonly both descends from and reacts against the same predecessor." and "English Palladian reacts against English Baroque and inherits its trades." styles/greek-revival-american.json lineage[reacts_against].note: "Greek Revival answers with mass", where the edge is drawn to federal-style, whose note also says "Federal had thinned American classicism until it was a membrane".
